{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-id-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"f4cf0df996e747c0b08732ffedd3b010b11e189a55f9f852e08b8b60f95e1e59","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-id-class-d:lineage:46","source_registry_sha256":"9c432577e712960022ff656d6738a091319c6e5e4dcbdcf9429cd450e142e543","source_liveness_sha256":"eee60602368bd429216c9c2833be0be6ed9e505e5c5accebaefb9d2b9a847475"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Parking, backing and freeway driving","heading":"C2 — Parking, backing and freeway driving","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Parking, backing and freeway driving

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A83
Before a long freeway trip, plan stops for fuel, food and rest. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A83
For a short freeway trip, know the route name and its route, entrance and exit numbers. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A83
Tell someone the travel plan, route, expected time away and return time. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A84
Confirm the desired entrance before taking its ramp; if it is wrong, do not reverse or turn around through the median. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A84
Ordinary vehicles may not use freeway median crossovers. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A84
Wait for the next exit when a freeway departure or direction change is needed. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A84
On an entrance ramp, check nearby and freeway traffic, signal and look over the left shoulder for a gap that fits the vehicle without crowding others. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A84
As the entrance ramp straightens, match freeway traffic speed while yielding to vehicles already on the highway. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A84
After matching traffic speed and merging with a lane change, switch off the turn signal. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A84
Shorter entrance ramps, acceleration lanes or merging areas, and heavy traffic, can require extra entry precautions. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R11 | anchor: A84
If heavy traffic leaves no entrance opening, slowing before the acceleration lane ends may be necessary. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R12 | anchor: A84
If a short acceleration lane and heavy traffic force a stop, leave room ahead to build speed for merging. [A84]
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec10-R13 | anchor: A85
On a freeway, maintain a steady speed with the traffic flow. [A85]
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-R14 | anchor: A85
A freeway may display a minimum speed as well as its other speed controls. [A85]
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-R15 | anchor: A85
Choose another type of road if unable or unwilling to drive at the freeway's posted speed. [A85]
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-R16 | anchor: A85
Normally use the far-right or center freeway lane; the left lane serves higher-speed traffic and passing. [A85]
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-R17 | anchor: A85
During rush hours, avoid the right freeway lane to leave room for entering vehicles. [A85]
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-R18 | anchor: A85
Signal for at least five seconds before changing freeway lanes or taking an exit. [A85]
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-R19 | anchor: A85
Outside the interstate exclusion, crossing a roadway's separating barrier or unpaved median is prohibited except at an authorized opening or crossover. [A85]
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec10-R20 | anchor: A85
For a freeway exit, identify the intended exit and follow signs to its departure lane. [A85]
Source: [A85 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0085]
